# dify_model_settings (Resource)

Manages one model's enablement and load-balancing settings. Load balancing is declarative: entries stored on the server but not listed in `load_balancing_entries` are deleted. One entry with `credential_id` unset (null) reuses the model's or provider's active credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dify_model_credential" "backup" {
  provider_name = "langgenius/openai/openai"
  model         = "gpt-4o-mini"
  model_type    = "llm"
  name          = "backup-key"

  credentials = {
    api_key = var.backup_openai_api_key
  }
}

# Enable the model with a load-balancing pool: the first entry inherits the
# model's active credential, the second pins a specific credential.
resource "dify_model_settings" "gpt4o_mini" {
  provider_name          = "langgenius/openai/openai"
  model                  = "gpt-4o-mini"
  model_type             = "llm"
  config_from            = "predefined-model"
  enabled                = true
  load_balancing_enabled = true

  load_balancing_entries = [
    { enabled = true },
    { credential_id = dify_model_credential.backup.credential_id, enabled = true },
  ]
}

variable "backup_openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

~> **Note:** `terraform destroy` resets the model to a clean state — `enabled = true`, load balancing off, all entries removed.

## Schema

### Required

- `config_from` (String) Which credential table load-balancing entries point at: `predefined-model` (provider credentials) or `custom-model` (the model's own).
- `model` (String) Model name.
- `model_type` (String) Model type (`llm`, `text-embedding`, `rerank`, `speech2text`, `tts`, `moderation`).
- `provider_name` (String) Model provider id (e.g. `langgenius/openai/openai`).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the model is enabled for this workspace.
- `load_balancing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether load balancing is on for this model.
- `load_balancing_entries` (Attributes List) Desired load-balancing entries, in order. `credential_id` references a saved credential; null names the entry that reuses the active credential (at most one). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancing_entries))

<a id="nestedatt--load_balancing_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancing_entries`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this entry participates in balancing.

Optional:

- `credential_id` (String) Saved credential id; null for the entry reusing the active credential.
